name: FA_TRANSFER_DISTS_T
description: FA_TRANSFERS_DISTS_T contains temporary storage data of asset distribution for transfer transactions.

columns.name: TRANSFER_INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset transfer interface row.

columns.name: LINE_ID
columns.description: Line identifier for transferring a distribution.

columns.name: SRC_LINE_ID
columns.description: Line identifier of the source asset for transferring a distribution.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset distribution.

columns.name: DEST_BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique destination book identification name.

columns.name: SRC_DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: Source book asset distribution identifier.

columns.name: LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Location flexfield identification number.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the account code combination for the depreciation expense account.

columns.name: ASSIGNED_TO
columns.description: Identifier of the employee to whom the asset is assigned.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_UNITS
columns.description: Number of units involved in the transaction. Negative value for the row from which the units were transferred away or retired. Positive value for the row to which the units were transferred to or added.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the loader job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
